Eligibility of Tenderer : 1. The minimum number of years of General Experience of the tenderer in the works as Contractor shall be Twelve (12) year.
Years in counting backward form the date of tender publication of IFT in e-Gp portal.
2. The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor in Survey works of at least 1(One) contract of the minimum value of the
similar nature, complexity and methods/construction technology successfully completed within the last 5(five) years, each with a
value of at least BDT.Tk.12.00 (Twelve) lac. Years counting back ward from the date of publication of IFT in e-Gp portal.
3. The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk. 33.00 (Thirty thee) lac in the last 5(Five) years.
Years counting back ward form the date of publication of Tender Notice/IFT of IFT in the e-gp portal.
4. The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities tender shall be 9.00 (Nine) lac only.
5. The Tender Capacity is Tk. 16.00 (Sixteen) lac. Supporting document must be submitted along within formation as per enclosed
form(on going works/commitments)
6. The Tenderer must enclose up-to-date Trade license, Income Tax clearance certificate & VAT registration certificate
7. Personnel Capacity & Equipment Capacity as per TDS.
Brief Description of Works : As-build drawing of KDA's Various installations, Residential plots, Commercial plots, buildings and roads through digital
topographic survey by total station Machine (Package-6). KDA taligati sorak including commercial plots, khalispur nuton raster
more to boyra bazer, Muzgunni Main Road ( BDR sector & pabla part) Mujguni residential area with Park, Boyra main road & jolil
shorini road including plot's, Dalutpur residential area, dalutpur market (kalpotaru). Construction & Installation of RCC demarcation
pillar. Digital Topographic Survey of 150 acre.
